text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... To think I'd get injured like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, training will be out of the 
question, and I might only be able to do 
seated streams...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“...No way, that won't do at all! I could 
never properly return everyone's love like 
that!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I'm totally fine, so let's 
get back to training!
choice_data_list:
No, I can't let you push yourself too 
hard.
...Let's look for something we can do.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, I'm totally fine, so let's 
get back to training!
choice_data_list:
No, I can't let you push yourself too 
hard.
...Let's look for something we can do.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No way...! Everyone's cheering for me 
because they want to see me run...!
choice_data_list:
I don't want to see you forcing yourself 
to run.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That is...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You're right... If I push myself too hard 
here, it could lead to an even worse 
injury...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa... Alright. I'll be good and rest 
up for now..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...! I won't push myself too 
hard, so don't worry ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Wait, ouch!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nghh... Even something this minor is no 
good...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating, but I'll stop here 
for now. I don't want to make everyone 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having aggravated her injury, she decided 
to quietly take some time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainer-kun♡ You really know 
what's up, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainer-chan♡ You really know 
what's up, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it feels like all my injuries just 
blew away thanks to Trainer-kun's love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with Trainer-chan's love, it feels 
like my injury was blown right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was within limits, Loves 
Only You happily moved her body around.
